interpretation.atomRole: Canvas atoms state grammar, evidence, analysis, or documentary propositions; they are not application axes.
interpretation.choiceRule: Only a typed application contract may declare a genuine user choice. An atom can supply provenance for that contract but cannot create UI or grammar authority.
interpretation.newAssertionEffect: The 13,292 new individual atom coordinates extend proof and provenance on existing canonical owners. They are non-generative and declare zero new application axes.
interpretation.directBridgeScope: The direct bridge records the Canvas propositions cited by the 58 existing genuine application choices; it is not a count of all grammar atoms affected by those owners.

codebooks.note: Global invariants apply uiAuthority=none and evidenceAbsenceBlocksGeneration=false to every tuple.
